title: Potatoes to Chips RP
description: Makes potatoes look like a box of maccas chips, I'll add more growth stages soon.
body: Making the game more interesting. Potatoes become a box of chips. Make sure my mod is above your main resource pack in minecraft menu otherwise it won't work. (Top is easiest, however if you have other ones requiring being on top,putting it right above main RP should be fine).
